Alignment.description:
It carries no timing and no stops, so it only draws. Any number of
patterns may run one ([`Pattern::alignment`]). An alignment that no
pattern runs still stands.

AlignmentPoint.description:
The distance is present where the publisher gave one, in the units of the
pattern stops. The fields are in canonical key order (RFC 8785), so
the canonical bytes stream in one pass.

Anchor.description:
`NoonMinusTwelve` is the GTFS convention. No DST transition occurs near
noon, so offsets stay unambiguous on change days.

AttributionScope.description: `None` on the attribution credits the whole dataset.

Block.description:
A block may hold trips of service types that never share a day. On each
day it is the trips that run that day, in this order.

last_day.description: For `PriorDays`. A day is a count of days before the ride.

Coord.description: A WGS84 position. The model never stores GeoJSON order, [lon, lat].

trips.description: Trip ids are unique across these and the scheduled trips.

zones.description: A GeoJSON FeatureCollection whose feature ids are the zone ids.

oneOf.description:
One instance at `start_secs + k * headway_secs` while the start is
`< end_secs`, for each band. All instances share the id and times of
the trip. Without `exact`, riders get the headway, not the minutes.

FareLegRule.description: Unset parts match any. The rule with the highest priority wins.

oneOf.description: Cash, or a fare paid with no medium.

FareOffer.description: An unset category or medium matches any.

after_trip.description: An index into the trips of the block.

index.description: 0 is the ground, and a negative index is below it.

anchor.description: Every offset in the network counts from it.

schema_version.description: A document without one is version 1.

station_parts.description: Ids are unique across these and the stops.

NetworkVersion.description: A network built in code is the current version.

both_ways.description: `false` when the pathway runs only from `from` to `to`.

alignment.description: An [`Alignment`] id. `None` means draw stop-to-stop lines.

direction.description:
One of the [`Route::directions`]. Bay and short-turn variants share a
direction. `None` when the route has none.

continuous_pickup.description: Applies from here to the next stop. `None` defers to the route.

distance_m.description: Meters along the pattern from its first stop, non-decreasing.

headsign.description:
Overrides the headsign of the trip at this visit only
(`visit_destination`).

timepoint.description:
Every trip carries both times here. Other stops may leave times
unscheduled.

PatternTrips.description:
The trips of one pattern under one service type. A timetable spans a
direction of a route across its patterns (`listing::timetable`).

PlanMeta.description:
Each pick is one document, effective from its service change date until
the next pick supersedes it. A document without plan metadata is
unversioned, such as a fresh GTFS import.

effective_from.description:
The service change date. None on unversioned documents. A plan in a
chain must have one.

id.description: The sync key (LWW for each plan). Empty on unversioned documents.

default.description: The category a rider is in unless they say otherwise.

Route.description:
`name` is the short name that riders see ("12"). Display a route by
[`Route::label`].

continuous_pickup.description: `None` means riders board and alight only at stops.

directions.description:
A pattern belongs to at most one. Empty for a route with no
directions.

name.description: Empty for a route that has only a long name.

operator.description: `None` is the only operator of the network.

vehicle_type.description: The published code for an extended type that `mode` does not say.

parent.description: For a boarding area, the platform.

transfer.description: Validation requires at least two routes to meet at a transfer point.

street_access.description:
`false` when riders reach the place only through the station, not
from the street.

timezone.description: Set only where it differs from the operator's.

wheelchair.description: `None` is unknown. A child place inherits its parent's.

StopOffset.description:
Seconds after the start of the instance. `None` means not scheduled there.
The first arrival is 0. The first and last stops, and every timepoint,
carry both times.

Timeframe.description: No start and end means the whole day.

TimingProfile.description:
The run times for new trips that depart in `[start_secs, end_secs)`.
`at_timepoints` has one entry for each timepoint, in pattern order. The
first entry is 0.

oneOf.description: The departing vehicle waits for the arriving one.
The rider stays in the vehicle from one trip to the next.

Translation.description:
`table` and `field` use the names of the published dataset ("stops",
"stop_name"). A text is found by `record` (and `sub_record` where a record
needs two keys) or by its value in the original language.

Trip.description:
`times[i]` is the time at `pattern.stops[i]`. The fields are in canonical
key order (RFC 8785), so the canonical bytes stream in one pass.

TripRef.description: A frequency trip in a block is every one of its instances, back to back.

Visit.description: Times and windows are seconds after the service-day anchor.

timepoint.description: `Some(true)` is an exact time. `Some(false)` is an approximate one.

WeekdaySet.description: A rule with no flags still runs on dates that are `Added`.
